name: Accessor
brief: The Accessor is a utility class to debug the Scene structure by traversing the scene-tree.
description: The Accessor helps you search specific nodes to read the property information, figure out the structure of the scene tree and its size.
warnings: We strongly warn you not to change the paints of a scene unless you really know the design-structure.
This class is not designed for inheritance.

members.name: set
members.signature: Result set(Paint* paint, std::function<bool(const Paint* paint, void* data)> func, void* data) noexcept
members.brief: Set the access function for traversing the Picture scene tree nodes.

params.name: paint
params.description: The paint node to traverse the internal scene-tree.

params.name: func
params.description: The callback function calling for every paint nodes of the Picture.

params.name: data
params.description: Data passed to the `func` as its argument.

notes: The bitmap based picture might not have the scene-tree.

members.name: id
members.signature: static uint32_t id(const char* name) noexcept
members.brief: Generate a unique ID (hash key) from a given name.
description: This function computes a unique identifier value based on the provided string. You can use this to assign a unique ID to the Paint object.

params.name: name
params.description: The input string to generate the unique identifier from.

members.name: name
members.brief: Retrieve the original name string from a given unique ID.
description: Returns the name associated with the specified identifier.
This method is only valid when Picture::accessible is set to `true` for the Picture associated with the given `paint` in Accessor::set() Otherwise, the name information may not be available.
members.returns: The corresponding name string, or `nullptr` if not found or unavailable.
notes: This function is only available within Accessor callbacks registered via Accessor::set().
